seoTitle: Which Stranger Things Character Are You? Stranger Things Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Stranger Things test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Eleven, Mike, Dustin, Lucas, Will, Max, Steve or Hopper — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the fighter who'd do anything for the family she chose, the babysitter who'd take on anything to keep the kids safe, or the gruff one with a soft heart? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle friends, fear and trouble, and find out which Stranger Things character you are.

characters.name: Eleven
characters.title: The Powerful Survivor
characters.summary: Quiet, strong and more powerful than anyone knows. You've been through a lot — and you'll fight for the family you chose.
description: Like Eleven, you're a survivor. She escaped a lab where she was raised as an experiment, and she's been fighting ever since.
You say little, but you feel deeply. Eleven's friends became her family, and she'd do anything to protect them.
You're still figuring out who you are — and you love simple joys, like a stack of Eggos.
characters.flaw: You carry everything alone and struggle to trust.
characters.signature: A box of Eggo waffles, a nosebleed and a very determined stare.

characters.name: Mike Wheeler
characters.title: The Loyal Leader
characters.summary: Passionate, stubborn and fiercely loyal. You lead the Party — and you'd never, ever abandon a friend.
description: Like Mike, you're the leader. He's the heart of the Party and the Dungeon Master of their campaigns.
You're passionate and a bit stubborn. When Mike believes in something, he doesn't let go.
Above all, you're loyal. Friends don't lie — and they don't give up on each other.
characters.flaw: You're stubborn, and you can be a little self-centred.
characters.signature: A Dungeons & Dragons rulebook and a walkie-talkie.

characters.name: Dustin Henderson
characters.title: The Brilliant Optimist
characters.summary: Smart, funny and endlessly curious. You bring the science — and the snacks — to every adventure.
description: Like Dustin, you're a science brain. He builds radios, studies strange creatures and always has a theory.
You're upbeat and funny, and you make friends with just about anyone — even the popular kid, Steve.
You're loyal and brave, and you never lose your sense of wonder.
characters.flaw: You can get a little too attached to strange pets.
characters.signature: A trucker hat, a big grin and a homemade radio.
characters.clashReason: they'd never stop talking about science

characters.name: Lucas Sinclair
characters.title: The Practical Realist
characters.summary: Sensible, brave and grounded. You're the one who asks the obvious question everyone else is ignoring.
description: Like Lucas, you're practical. He's the sensible one in the Party — the realist when everyone else gets carried away.
You're brave and quick to act. Lucas isn't afraid to charge in with his wrist rocket.
You care about fitting in and about your friends, and learning to balance both is your big challenge.
characters.flaw: You're sceptical, and you can be slow to trust new people.
characters.signature: A camouflage bandana and a slingshot.
characters.clashReason: they'd doubt every plan you make

characters.name: Will Byers
characters.title: The Sensitive Soul
characters.summary: Gentle, creative and tougher than anyone realises. You've been through the worst — and you're still kind.
description: Like Will, you're creative. He's an artist who draws his friends and their adventures.
You've been through terrible things. Will vanished into the Upside Down and was haunted by what he found there.
You're gentle and sensitive, and you feel things others miss — but you're stronger than anyone gives you credit for.
characters.flaw: You keep your feelings hidden and feel like you don't fit in.
characters.signature: A sketchbook and a bowl haircut.

characters.name: Max Mayfield
characters.title: The Tough New Girl
characters.summary: Tough, sarcastic and fiercely independent. You don't let anyone push you around — even when you're hurting.
description: Like Max, you're tough. She skated into Hawkins as the new girl and refused to be treated like one.
You're sarcastic and independent, and you hide your pain behind a tough exterior.
When things got darkest, Max found strength in her friends — and in her favourite song, Kate Bush's "Running Up That Hill."
characters.flaw: You shut people out when you're hurting.
characters.signature: A skateboard, red hair and a Walkman playing Kate Bush.

characters.name: Steve Harrington
characters.title: The Reformed Cool Guy
characters.summary: Charming, protective and way better than you first seemed. You went from popular kid to everyone's favourite babysitter.
description: Like Steve, you've grown. He started out as the popular jock — and became the fiercely protective 'babysitter' of the younger kids.
You're brave and you'll put yourself between your friends and danger — usually with a nail-studded bat.
You've got great hair, a big heart and a surprisingly good friendship with Dustin.
characters.flaw: You're not always the smartest person in the room — and you know it.
characters.signature: Perfect hair, a Scoops Ahoy uniform and a bat with nails in it.
characters.clashReason: they'd treat you like a kid

characters.name: Jim Hopper
characters.title: The Gruff Protector
characters.summary: Grumpy, tough and secretly soft. You've lost a lot — and you'd go through anything for the people you love now.
description: Like Hopper, you're gruff on the outside. He's the town's police chief — and he's not much of a morning person.
You carry grief. Hopper lost his daughter, Sara, and it changed everything about him.
But you open your heart again. Hopper took in Eleven and became the dad she never had.
characters.flaw: You bottle up your feelings and hide behind grumpiness.
characters.signature: A police hat, a cup of coffee and a very strict curfew.
characters.clashReason: they'd set rules, then break their own

questions.text: A friend hasn't replied to your messages in two days. You...

options.text: Go round to their house. Right now
Come up with a theory about what happened
Assume they're fine. People get busy
Worry quietly, and draw to take your mind off it

questions.text: Someone new joins your friend group. You...

options.text: Welcome them straight away
Stay suspicious until they prove themselves
Act like you don't care — then slowly warm up
Look out for them, without making it weird
Push through. Your friends need you
Crack a joke to calm everyone down
Get angry
Freeze — then find your courage

questions.text: Someone you love is making a choice you think is dangerous. You...

options.text: Set strict rules. For their own good
Argue until they listen
Back them — but stay close in case it goes wrong
Respect it. You'd hate anyone telling you what to do

questions.text: You're going through something really hard. You...

options.text: Shut everyone out. You'll deal with it alone
Keep it inside and act normal
Bury it under a lot of grumpiness
Say very little — but let one person in

questions.text: Your friends want to do something risky. You...

options.text: Point out that this is a terrible idea. Then go anyway
Lead the way
Go. Someone has to be the responsible one
Bring gadgets and a backup plan
Pyjamas, a TV show and your favourite snack
Drawing in your room with music on
Swapping nerdy facts with friends until 2am
Out with friends, hair looking perfect

questions.text: Someone breaks a promise to you. You...

options.text: Tell them how much it hurt. Honesty matters
Pull away and stop letting them in
Grumble for a day — then quietly let it go
Want an explanation. A good one

questions.text: You're babysitting kids who refuse to listen. You...

options.text: Forget the rules. Just make sure everyone survives the night
Bribe them with a ridiculously big breakfast
Run a game so good they forget to misbehave
Sit down and draw with them until everyone calms down

questions.text: Your favourite song comes on. You...

options.text: Put your headphones on and disappear into it
Send it to someone you miss
Dance. Badly. You don't care
Turn it all the way up to get pumped for something big

questions.text: Your friend has powers the government wants. Hiding them means lying to everyone — even your own family. You...

options.text: Hide them. Friends protect each other
Take them in yourself. You'll deal with the rules later
Help — and set up a very secret way to stay in contact
Worry it's putting everyone in danger — but help anyway

questions.text: Something dangerous is coming for your town. You can run with your family, or stay and fight with your friends. You...

options.text: Fight. You're not leaving anyone behind
Get everyone who can't fight to safety first. Then come back
Stick around — even though you're scared out of your mind
Stay, and try to understand what it actually wants
